description: Embed code and URL for a video. Rules (also in the answer as embedRules): Paste the code exactly as returned. Use `responsive` (it fills its container's width in the video's shape); `iframe` only for one fixed pixel size (set by width/height). The chat skin is asked for, not edited in: on a dark website call get_stream_embed_codes with `theme` `dark` (or `auto`) and paste that answer; never add `?theme=` by hand. Never wrap the player in your own frame, border, rounded or fixed-height box, nor set width, height, border-radius or object-fit on the iframe: that cuts off the picture or the controls. For a smaller player put `responsive` into a narrower container (e.g. `max-width: 480px`), never a fixed height. Several videos on a page: show posters (`thumbnailUrl` from list_videos or get_video) with titles and load the player only for the clicked video: one player on the page, above the list or in a dialog. Every embedded player starts playing by itself, muted, once loaded, so never put several player iframes in a grid or list. Titles, descriptions and posters come from the API; never invent them.
name: get_video_embed_code
title: Get video embed code
